Heidelberg School Walking Guide

Select a painter or painting, read its story, view the work, and open walking directions to the associated landscape.

Self-contained prototype: all buttons and painting records are embedded in this single file. Locations are classified by confidence and should not all be interpreted as exact easel positions.

Numbered field map

Tap a number to open its painting record. Navigation opens in Google Maps.

Painting sites

This prototype covers Central Heidelberg and Eaglemont. Painting-image links go to gallery records, public-domain sources or image searches until authorised reproductions are verified.
